newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria to make public CA bidders Dec 16 - report.
newsitem.headline: Austria to make public CA bidders Dec 16 - report.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima will make public the bidders for Creditanstalt-Bankverein next Monday when the final deadline for firm offers expires, Austrian news agency APA reported on Tuesday.
APA quoted Klima as saying he would release the names of the bidders but would not give information on price or content.
No one at the finance ministry could confirm the report.

The marathon privatisation of Austria's second biggest bank, started in 1990, has entered its final stage with Klima determined to settle the fate of the state's 70 percent of ordinary voting shares by year-end.

Klima has said there are two indicative bidders for the bank. Only a consortium headed by insurer EA-Generali and including Die Erste Oesterreichische SparCasse (First Austrian) has so far come out into the open. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
